title: Valid State Codes
applicability: Applies to Segment 100 Terminal Identifier and conditional card-discretionary/state-context data.

businessRequirements.title: Terminal Identifier Element 102 shall contain a valid two-digit ANSI state code from Appendix D in its defined terminal identity structure.
Alphabetical state codes used in Card Discretionary Block Data or state context shall use an Appendix D alphabetical code.
A non-US/non-Canada location using numeric state code 00 shall include Variable Information Table 041 country subdivision data.

testCases.positive: Terminal Identifier contains valid ANSI state code such as 06 for California
negative: alphabetical code used where ANSI numeric code is required

testCases.positive: Card Discretionary data contains valid alphabetical state code
Numeric 00 is accompanied by Variable Information Table 041

testDataStatus: Terminal Identifier format and dependency tests exist; complete Appendix D state-code enumeration and Table 041 execution require dedicated response/configuration evidence.
remaining: Validate all Appendix D code sets against AI-generated Terminal Identifier and Card Discretionary data.
Validate Table 041 through actual serialized Variable Information data.
